title: Manufacture v1: Pipeline
description: Ordered stages. A stage runs one step, several parallel steps, or one step per item of a list (foreach). Rules that span several fields (exactly one of step/parallel, route targets, loop limits, CEL) are checked by `manufacture validate`.

trigger.description: How runs start. Manual runs (UI, API, mfctl run) are always allowed.

source.description: Module that emits run requests (source module).

schedule.description: Cron expression with 5 fields (minute hour day month weekday) or a descriptor such as @daily.

count_waiting.description: Runs in waiting_human hold a max_runs slot. By default they do not (a resumed run continues without admission, so max_runs may be exceeded for a while).

min_interval.description: Minimum time between the starts (admissions) of two runs of this pipeline.

priority.description: Default priority of new runs, -100..100. Higher is admitted and dispatched first; FIFO within a priority.

budget.description: Cost limits over usage.cost_usd that modules report. Reaching run_usd cancels the unconfirmed attempts and parks the run in needs_attention (budget_exceeded); day_usd keeps new runs queued (reason day_budget).

run_usd.description: Per run; an operator may raise it with PATCH /runs/{id}/budget.

warn_usd.description: Emit run.budget_warning once when a run spends this much; must be below run_usd.

day_usd.description: Per pipeline and day (MF_BUDGET_DAY_TZ, UTC by default).

max_bytes.description: Largest run data after a merge; a step that exceeds it fails with fatal data_too_large. Default 196608 (192 KiB).

defaults.description: Defaults applied to every step that does not set the field.

foreach.description: CEL expression returning a list; the stage step runs once per item.

input.description: Input projection: field name -> CEL expression. Without it the step receives run data.

on_cancel.description: What an operator cancel of this step does to the run (a run cancel always cancels the run).

wait.description: The step may wait (step.waiting) for a human or an external system. Allowed only on a single-step stage.

timeout.description: Total time the step may spend in waiting; 7d by default. on_timeout applies when it expires.

min_budget_usd.description: Overrides the module min_budget_usd for this step.

merge.description: data: the step output is merged into run data (JSON Merge Patch); none: kept only under steps.<id>.output.

optional.description: A fatal failure of an optional step does not fail the run.

onTimeout.description: What happens when timeout (counted from the first heartbeat, waiting excluded) or wait.timeout expires: retry (new attempt of the same visit, the same step_key, within retry.max_attempts; then needs_attention), fail (the step fails), attention (the run goes to needs_attention). Default retry. A confirmed attempt is never retried: it goes to needs_attention (outcome_unknown).

merge.description: What to do when parallel steps write the same key of run data.

max_visits.description: How many times the target stage may run within one run. Required for backward jumps (loops).
